messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Good afternoon everyone!

We will have our next meeting of the R group this Friday at noon in Stone G158 or zoom (https://fsu.zoom.us/j/97381084243<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F97381084243&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C3f2d8c4799b84f3c3b5b08dccd12ab4b%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638610727268986329%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=dM6oLJBrjvUH09Bd3E54SwjO1FhyOcJWAZ0XMhEx3z8%3D&reserved=0>).  We will be exploring a new tool for R, called Jamovi, that is a more graphical interface to R.

If you have ever wished that SPSS was free, or that R would be a little more like SPSS, this will be a great week to join us.

We will also be heading upstairs to the EPLS suite after R group to celebrate Dr. Almond's birthday with some game time!

I hope many of you will join us for some R fun, some game fun, or both!



Kari Roberts

Director of Strategic Planning and Assessment

Division of Student Affairs

Florida State University

313 Westcott Building

Tallahassee, FL 32306-1340

To view this email as a web page, go here.<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fview.message.fsu.edu%2F%3Fqs%3D55d6185ea420da01bd90329c66964eb20594eea0a4da9f22afd3d946639530301cfee5f979e4297307e09c8383cbcc853972472638717cf95fc8d0bd567e3145a359a0d7a73420b6b6faa2d7f9da09c9&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C179ed8def3424b86c31608dce1691cc9%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638633088771072633%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=gvriQOeCpLkDAq1ZfhXr%2FqUEphkIrTXB%2BUBxxVZ6ycw%3D&reserved=0>

Data @ Your Desk Series : Introduction to SQL

Tuesday, October 1 | 3 - 4:30pm
Zoom Livestream<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fclick.message.fsu.edu%2F%3Fqs%3D3566a74c9237239c302b90ee3ab47bee69c94d6a4ceecaaf3c11a9d2aa1ce48c0eafbb2595b579ab092af17134946ec73a270a41d14b5420&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C179ed8def3424b86c31608dce1691cc9%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638633088771072633%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=uxLkrCJGtxKWIoJVWdnplvlRCiPtwbGCdzaT1zKY9fc%3D&reserved=0> and Dirac Science Library Teaching Lab (Room 208<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fclick.message.fsu.edu%2F%3Fqs%3D3566a74c9237239c6a18922850349345a1a1a2d965ff396c29ef43b3086f6e75c2f8ea83f6538af4add6f892c9d283705c28b2094803770d&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C179ed8def3424b86c31608dce1691cc9%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638633088771228896%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=TkV6k3yXabYw5EXB3Sl6sR9O%2FXyrXprDFh7ZCI4zgss%3D&reserved=0>)

The SQL workshop provides an introduction to relational databases and SQL. Topics covered:

  *   Basics of relational databases, including what a Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) is
  *   How to model a simple database, including the significance of keys and unique values in structuring tables
  *   Best practices, including avoiding composite keys, using consistent table naming conventions, and implementing arbitrary identifiers (surrogate keys)
  *   Introduction to SQL statements and simple table joins
  *   How to continue learning about the concepts after the workshop

See more details and register ?<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fclick.message.fsu.edu%2F%3Fqs%3D3566a74c9237239c78ca217e1fc9febe9da13c388024dbf1c01bad0677a289ab9e0bcdb5a83a0598cfc8c81bac1af20b81b736255c0c215b&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C179ed8def3424b86c31608dce1691cc9%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638633088771228896%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Ne71rtITEsgibSmsfgHiLobZVxIZqXeI%2BW7xMFCai9o%3D&reserved=0>
